title: Audio-Visual and Videoconferencing Engineer (Poly, Pexip, Crestron) for NATO with security clearance
description: When senior leaders join a call, the screen has to work. Every time. A multinational defence organisation in Mons runs a large estate of videoconferencing infrastructure and meeting room systems, and needs a hands-on AV specialist to deliver new installations, keep the back-end healthy and patched, and steadily raise the quality of the service. What You Would Be Doing Delivering new AV and videoconferencing installations for customer projects, from room layouts and implementation plans to the documentation needed for accreditation Patching and upgrading back-end systems and room devices to approved vendor releases with little or no downtime Administering and maintaining the back-end and front-end as the subject matter expert Improving monitoring and maintenance so problems are caught before users notice them Proposing service improvements that cut the need for support calls What you would bring At least 3 years with HP/Poly and Pexip videoconferencing, including Poly Clariti Core/Edge, Clariti Manager and Pexip back-end infrastructure At least 3 years managing AV room systems: Poly and Cisco codecs, Poly and Panasonic cameras, Epson projectors, NEC monitors, Crestron and Extron control and video matrices, Televic microphones and video walls Around 2 years integrating communication systems with Active Directory and PKI, especially on Cisco products Experience with monitoring platforms such as nGeniusOne, CA Performance Management or CA Spectrum, and with Splunk log analysis Solid basic network troubleshooting, including boundary protection devices Why this one is worth a look It is a specialist seat where your AV depth matters every day, on a big, varied estate.
